# ArtHop - Camano Island, WA

> A free, self-guided art tour of galleries, studios, and creative spaces on Camano Island, Washington. Gifts of fine art and craft from local artists.

- Dates: Friday-Saturday, December 4-5, 2026
- Hours: 10am-4pm both days
- Where: 5 locations on Camano Island, WA, all within about 2 miles
- Cost: Free
- Website: https://camanoarthop.com/
- Facebook event: https://www.facebook.com/events/2341991139898609/
- Calendar file: https://camanoarthop.com/arthop-2026.ics

## Locations

### 1. LB Art Glass

- Address: 679 Awa Ln, Camano Island, WA 98282
- Artists: [Lee Beitz](https://camanoarts.org/gallery/lee-beitz/)
- About: A Gift for Everyone. Glass Pendants, Earrings, Nail Files, Ornaments, Candle Holders, Plates, Bowls, Wall Sconces, Tables, Garden Art and so much more!
- Email: LBART1@FRONTIER.COM
- Phone: 360-387-2639
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=679%20Awa%20Ln%20Camano%20Island%20WA%2098282

### 2. Matzke Fine Art Gallery & Sculpture Park

- Address: 2345 Blanche Way, Camano Island, WA 98282
- Notes: "Honey I Shrunk the Art" - 40 artists, annual gallery show
- Regular hours: Open every Friday - Saturday - Sunday 11-5; Monday - Thursday by Appt.
- Website: http://www.matzkefineart.com/
- Email: matzke@camano.net
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=2345%20Blanche%20Way%20Camano%20Island%20WA%2098282

### 3. Dragon's Gate Studios

- Address: 2296 S Camano Dr, Camano Island, WA 98282
- Artists: [Dolors Rushà](https://foreverartglass.com/), [Marc Boutté](https://camanoarts.org/gallery/marc-boutte/), [Marie-Claire Dole](https://www.marie-clairejeweler.com/)
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=2296%20S%20Camano%20Dr%20Camano%20Island%20WA%2098282

### 4. South Camano Grange

- Address: 2227 S Camano Dr, Camano Island, WA 98282
- Hours: Fri Dec 4 & Sat Dec 5, 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM
- Notes: Two-day Holiday Market with local artists and craftspeople selling handmade gifts, plus live music both days. Camano.fm broadcasts the whole event live from the Grange. Krampus photos Friday 2-4 PM, hosted by Evergreen Farm (sponsor) and Krampus Stanwood. Tree Lighting Saturday at 4 PM.
- Website: https://southcamanogrange.org
- Email: southcamano930@gmail.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61589962162322
- News: [Local farm partners with South Camano Grange to launch monthly market](https://www.goskagit.com/scnews/local-farm-partners-with-south-camano-grange-to-launch-monthly-market/article_690d9712-4a65-4b83-b834-c05c7dd5e519.html)
- News: [South Camano Grange gets facelift thanks to grant funding](https://www.goskagit.com/scnews/south-camano-grange-gets-facelift-thanks-to-grant-funding/article_5726e4b6-cbe8-11ef-9532-8356b4f0dbb9.html)
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=2227%20S%20Camano%20Dr%20Camano%20Island%20WA%2098282

### 5. The Compound

- Address: 159 E Dry Lake Rd, Camano Island, WA 98282
- Artists: [Monika DeNasha](https://www.matzkefineart.com/artists-2/monika-denasha-bead-work-collage/), [Doug Landreth](https://douglandreth.com/), [Brenda Bolte](https://ambientart.com/), [David Taber](https://davidtaberart.wixsite.com/stickandstone), [Lisa Dahl](https://lisadahl.co/about/), [Amy Bush](https://loyalsmith.com/)
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=159%20E%20Dry%20Lake%20Rd%20Camano%20Island%20WA%2098282
